g.text: One synthetic next-token distribution over 40 tokens, log scale. Temperature reshapes the whole distribution; top-k and top-p

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475569

g.text: truncate it. The reason top-p is usually preferred: a fixed k is too permissive when the model is confident and too restrictive

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475569

g.text: when it is not, whereas nucleus sampling adapts its cutoff to the shape of each distribution.
